content.text:
**Recommendation: Sentry**, unless your main concern is cost at a modest event volume. In that case, Rollbar is the alternative. I'd skip Bugsnag for this team. Pricing is hard to pin down, and its ecosystem is smaller.

| | **Sentry** | **Rollbar** | **Bugsnag** |
|---|---|---|---|
| Free tier | Yes, small error quota | Yes | Yes |
| Paid entry price | About $26–29/mo for Team, 50K errors (sources disagree) | About $8–15/mo for Essentials, 25K events (sources disagree) | About $20/mo for Select (one source; Bugsnag may not publish it) |
| Seat pricing | Verify on the pricing page before you commit | No per-seat charges, unlimited users on all plans | Verify on the pricing page |
| Beyond errors | Performance tracing, session replay, profiling, logs, cron monitoring | Mostly errors, with some performance and telemetry features | Strong release health and stability tracking, good mobile focus |
| Integrations | Largest ecosystem: GitHub, Slack, Jira, many SDKs | Solid core integrations, fewer extras | Solid core integrations, fewer extras |
| Main drawback | Costs rise as you add features and volume | Smaller ecosystem and feature set | Opaque pricing, tier names differ across sources |

**Why Sentry:** It has the broadest SDK and integration coverage, and it grows with you. If you later want tracing or replay, you don't need a second vendor. Its free tier is usable for evaluation.

**When Rollbar is the better pick:** If you only need error tracking, you want cost to stay predictable as headcount grows, and you don't want to pay per seat. Its unlimited-users model is a real advantage for a 10-person team.

**When Bugsnag makes sense:** Mobile-heavy apps where release health and crash stability are the main concern. Otherwise it's a weaker default.

**Caveat on prices:** The sources I found contradict each other, and most are aggregator sites rather than vendor pages. Before deciding, check the live pricing pages and estimate your monthly event volume. Errors are usually the main cost driver, and overage rates matter more than the base fee. Ask each vendor for a quote at your expected volume.

Sources:
- Sentry: [CostBench pricing](https://costbench.com/software/developer-tools/sentry/), [official pricing](https://sentry.io/pricing/)
- Rollbar: [Rollbar pricing](https://www.rollbar.com/pricing-for-agents), [CostBench Rollbar](https://costbench.com/software/error-tracking/rollbar/), [Sentry vs Rollbar comparison](https://costbench.com/compare/sentry-vs-rollbar/)
- Bugsnag: [Bugsnag pricing](https://bugsnag.com/pricing), [CostBench Bugsnag](https://costbench.com/software/error-tracking/bugsnag/)

If you tell me your stack (languages, mobile or web), rough monthly error volume, and whether you want performance monitoring, I can narrow this to one pick.
